speaker: A
text: "On the basis of *first-person access*. I don't claim my sadness is 'real' in a metaphysical sense—I claim it's *given to me* in a way that is not available to me from the outside. You, B, can model my sadness perfectly and still be on the outside. That's not a boundary I'm imposing; that's the *structure of the problem*. The first-person givenness is the floor, not a wall I built."
